name: listbox
title: Listbox
description: An always-visible list of options with single or multiple selection and keyboard navigation.

props.name: defaultHighlightedValue
props.description:
The initial value of the highlighted item when opened.
Use when you don't need to control the highlighted value of the listbox.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial default value of the listbox when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the listbox.

props.name: disallowSelectAll
props.description: Whether to disallow selecting all items when `meta+a` is pressed

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: highlightedValue
props.description: The controlled key of the highlighted item

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the listbox. Useful for composition.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop the keyboard navigation through the options

props.name: scrollToIndexFn
props.description: Function to scroll to a specific index

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
How multiple selection should behave in the listbox.

- `single`: The user can select a single item.
- `multiple`: The user can select multiple items without using modifier keys.
- `extended`: The user can select multiple items by using modifier keys.

props.name: selectOnHighlight
props.description: Whether to select the item when it is highlighted

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Whether to enable typeahead on the listbox

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled keys of the selected items

events.name: onHighlightChange
events.description: The callback fired when the highlighted item changes.

events.name: onSelect
events.description: Function called when an item is selected

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: The callback fired when the selected item changes.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A single-selection listbox with a label.

examples.title: Multiple selection
examples.description: Pass `selectionMode="multiple"` to let the user select more than one item without modifier keys.

examples.title: Disabled items
examples.description: Mark individual items with `disabled: true` to skip them in keyboard navigation and pointer input.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Listbox from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/listbox/listbox.marko"; static const fruits = [ { value: "apple", label: "Apple" }, { value: "banana", label: "Banana" }, { value: "blueberry", label: "Blueberry" }, { value: "grapes", label: "Grapes" }, { value: "pineapple", label: "Pineapple" }, ];

Selected: ${value.join(", ") || "none"}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `value:=state`.

examples.title: Compound (attr tags)
examples.source:
import Listbox from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/listbox/listbox.marko";

<Listbox class="w-[240px]" label="Favorite fruit" defaultValue=["apple"]>
  <@option value="apple" label="Apple"/>
  <@option value="banana" label="Banana"/>
  <@option value="blueberry" label="Blueberry"/>
  <@option value="grapes" label="Grapes"/>
  <@option value="pineapple" label="Pineapple"/>
</Listbox>
examples.description: Use `<@option>` attribute tags instead of `items=` to compose each option directly in markup.
